publish.title: Sleep is part of training
publish.description: How many hours adults need, according to the CDC, and four habits that help.

scenes.headline: Training happens in bed
scenes.narration: You can do everything right in the gym and still undercut it at night.

scenes.headline: Recovery is part of the plan
scenes.narration: You challenge your muscles in the gym, but you recover between sessions. Sleep is a big part of that recovery.

scenes.headline: How much sleep
scenes.narration: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says adults need seven or more hours of sleep a night.

scenes.headline: What helps
scenes.narration: The CDC suggests a steady schedule, a quiet, cool bedroom, no electronic devices for thirty minutes before bed, and no caffeine late in the day.
items: No caffeine late in the day

scenes.headline: Protect tonight
scenes.narration: Set a bedtime tonight and keep it for a week. If you struggle to sleep, talk to a doctor.
